commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Even if an unlearned man’s intelligence happens at times to be very good, the wise don’t count it as intelligence. It can’t be good, and if it is, that is mere chance, like letters traced in sand by a snail. So those with settled knowledge of the books pay it no regard.
